questions.question: What is the rule of noon sakinah or tanween before the letter ب?
questions.explanation: Iqlab: noon sakinah/tanween before ب turns into a meem with ghunnah.

questions.question: What is the rule of noon sakinah or tanween before the letters ل or ر?
questions.explanation: Before ل and ر the noon is merged without ghunnah (إدغام بغير غنة).

questions.question: Which letters make up the Idhar Halqi group (noon sakinah before them is shown clearly)?
choices: ء هـ ع ح غ خ
questions.explanation: Idhar Halqi letters are the six throat letters: ء هـ ع ح غ خ.

questions.question: Which letters are the letters of Qalqalah?
choices: خ ص ض ظ غ ق
ء هـ ع ح غ خ
questions.explanation: Qalqalah letters: ق ط ب ج د — they echo when sakin.

questions.question: How many harakat (counts) is the natural madd (المد الطبيعي) held?
questions.explanation: The natural madd is held two harakat.

questions.question: How many harakat is the compulsory madd (المد اللازم) held?
questions.explanation: The compulsory madd is held six harakat.

questions.question: The ghunnah (nasal sound) comes from which two letters?
questions.explanation: Ghunnah is the nasal sound produced from ن and م (especially when mushaddad).

questions.question: Which letters are the letters of Isti'laa (heavy, mufakhkham)?
choices: خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق
ء هـ ع ح غ خ
questions.explanation: Isti'laa letters: خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق — always recited heavy.

questions.question: What is the rule of meem sakinah before the letter ب?
questions.explanation: Meem sakinah before ب is hidden with ghunnah (إخفاء شفوي).

questions.question: Which letters make up the Idgham with ghunnah group?
choices: ء هـ ع ح غ خ
questions.explanation: Idgham with ghunnah applies before ي ن م و.

questions.question: How many surahs are in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran contains 114 surahs.

questions.question: Which is the longest surah in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah is the longest surah, with 286 ayahs.

questions.question: Which is the shortest surah in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Kawthar has just 3 ayahs.

questions.question: Which surah contains the first verses revealed to the Prophet (peace be upon him)?
questions.explanation: The first revelation was the opening of Surah Al-Alaq (Iqra).

questions.question: Which surah is equal to a third of the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said Al-Ikhlas equals a third of the Quran.

questions.question: How many juz (parts) is the Quran divided into?
questions.explanation: The Quran is divided into 30 juz.

questions.question: How many ayahs does Surah Al-Fatihah have?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah has 7 ayahs.

questions.question: Which surah is known as the heart of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Ya-Sin is called the heart of the Quran.

questions.question: Which surah is named after an insect?
questions.explanation: An-Naml (The Ant) is named after the ant.

questions.question: Ayat al-Kursi is found in which surah?
questions.explanation: Ayat al-Kursi is ayah 255 of Al-Baqarah.

questions.question: How many rak'ahs are in the Fajr prayer?
questions.explanation: Fajr consists of two rak'ahs.

questions.question: How many pillars does Islam have?
questions.explanation: Islam is built on five pillars.

questions.question: In which month was the Quran revealed?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed in Ramadan.

questions.question: How many times does the basmalah appear in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The basmalah appears 114 times (113 at surah openings plus one inside An-Naml).

questions.question: How many names of Allah (Al-Asma' ul-Husna) are there?
questions.explanation: Allah has 99 beautiful names.

questions.question: How many prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran?
questions.explanation: 25 prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran.

questions.question: What was the name of the mother of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)?
questions.explanation: His mother was Aminah bint Wahb.

questions.question: How many gates does Paradise have?
questions.explanation: Paradise has eight gates.

questions.question: Zakah is which pillar of Islam in order?
questions.explanation: The pillars are: Shahada, Salah, Zakah, Sawm, Hajj.

questions.question: Which prayer is the first thing a servant is held to account for on the Day of Judgment?
questions.explanation: The first thing accounted for is the prayer, per the hadith.
